title: #266 Improving living standards
prompt: In order to improve living standards, it is inevitable to destroy the environment. Do you agree with this statement or not?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point argues that building better homes and cities requires taking natural resources, which damages the environment.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point argues that building better homes and cities requires taking natural resources, which damages the environment.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point argues that modern living requires energy, and burning fuel for power pollutes the air and damages the environment.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second point argues that modern living requires energy, and burning fuel for power pollutes the air and damages the environment.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Improving living standards does not require damaging the environment because simple changes in daily life can help keep the planet clean.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Improving living standards does not require damaging the environment because simple changes in daily life can help keep the planet clean.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A clean lifestyle is possible, showing that we can improve our lives without damaging nature.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A clean lifestyle is possible, showing that we can improve our lives without damaging nature.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Economic growth necessitates utilizing natural resources, such as cutting down trees and digging up minerals for infrastructure and goods, which inevitably causes pollution and landscape changes.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Economic growth necessitates utilizing natural resources, such as cutting down trees and digging up minerals for infrastructure and goods, which inevitably causes pollution and landscape changes.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Modern living requires significant energy, often generated by burning fossil fuels, which releases harmful gases, lowers air quality, and contributes to global warming.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Modern living requires significant energy, often generated by burning fossil fuels, which releases harmful gases, lowers air quality, and contributes to global warming.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Improving living standards does not require environmental damage, as modern technology offers ways to live well while protecting nature.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Improving living standards does not require environmental damage, as modern technology offers ways to live well while protecting nature.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: People can improve their lives by focusing on sustainable practices, which helps use resources wisely and keeps towns healthy.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: People can improve their lives by focusing on sustainable practices, which helps use resources wisely and keeps towns healthy.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: evaluate the statement that improving living standards inevitably leads to environmental destruction, presenting both supporting and opposing arguments to form a balanced perspective.
keyArguments: Economic development often leads to environmental damage through industrialization and resource exploitation.
Sustainable practices and technological advancements can mitigate environmental impact while improving living standards.
